rungs.title: Junior Product Designer
rungs.summary: Learning how product decisions are made and tested.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the product, its users and the design tools; learns how discovery works.
rungs.delivery: Designs features from a defined problem, with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Shares work early and learns to explain why, not just what.

rungs.title: Product Designer
rungs.summary: Owns the design of a feature from problem to shipped.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in discovery, requirements, the design system and usability testing.
rungs.delivery: Takes a problem to a shipped, measured feature with light review.
rungs.leadership: Works as an equal with product and engineering; facilitates workshops.

rungs.title: Senior Product Designer
rungs.summary: Owns the experience of a product area and its results.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in research, data and systems thinking; designs AI features responsibly.
rungs.delivery: Owns a product area's experience and proves its impact with data.
rungs.leadership: Mentors, shapes roadmaps with product and builds relationships with customers.

rungs.title: Lead Product Designer
rungs.summary: Leads design for a product and its team.
rungs.knowledge: Connects product vision, business model and design system.
rungs.delivery: Owns design delivery across a product and its quality bar.
rungs.leadership: Leads designers and works at the same table as the product leads.

rungs.title: Head of Product Design
rungs.summary: Sets design strategy for all products.
rungs.knowledge: Connects design to strategy, pricing and brand across the portfolio.
rungs.delivery: Owns design strategy, budget and outcomes.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and represents design to the executive team.
